MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.title: Whose Illusion
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.pages:
[jitter][b]The flames twist before your eyes, the air thick with the smell of rust and ink.[/b][/jitter]
The bonfire is no longer a bonfire—it splits open into a crack. Beyond the crack, something [jitter][b]is watching[/b][/jitter] you.
A [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] comes from the depths, as if reading a verdict:
[jitter][color=#cccccc]「You have come. Then let the witch trial begin」[/color][/jitter]

You step forward. The [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] laughs. You feel some power surge into your body, but you know—the enemy ahead is no longer the one you thought it was
Gain 13 Max HP, upgrade a card, but the Boss will be replaced

You step back. A [jitter][color=#cccccc]【sigh】[/color][/jitter] comes from the crack. The pain of your wounds eases, but that [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] lingers in your mind
Heal 13 HP, upgrade a card

The crack closes behind you. Your body feels lighter, but your heart grows heavier. At the tower top ahead, no ordinary monster awaits you. The [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] whispers in your ear:
[jitter][color=#cccccc]「Come, [/color][/jitter][b][color=#ff99cc]witch[/color][/b][jitter][color=#cccccc]. I will wait for you at the end」[/color][/jitter]

Your wounds heal as if by miracle, but your fingers tremble. You look down at your hand and find you are holding a [b][color=#CC6666]pen[/color][/b]. Who gave it to you? You don't know. The bonfire returns to normal. But you know—this is certainly not the last time you will see that illusion
